sun.net.www.protocol.ftp

类 FtpURLConnection

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.net.URLConnection
      • sun.net.www.URLConnection
        • sun.net.www.protocol.ftp.FtpURLConnection

  • public class FtpURLConnection
extends URLConnection
    This class Opens an FTP input (or output) stream given a URL. It works as a one shot FTP transfer :
    • Login
    • Get (or Put) the file
    • Disconnect
    You should not have to use it directly in most cases because all will be handled in a abstract layer. Here is an example of how to use the class :

    URL url = new URL("ftp://ftp.sun.com/pub/test.txt");

    UrlConnection con = url.openConnection();

    InputStream is = con.getInputStream();

    ...

    is.close();

    另请参阅:
    FtpClient

      protected class  FtpURLConnection.FtpOutputStream
      For FTP URLs we need to have a special OutputStream because we need to close 2 sockets after we're done with it : - The Data socket (for the file)

      • connect

        public void connect()
             throws IOException
        Connects to the FTP server and logs in.
        指定者:
        connect 在类中 URLConnection
        抛出:
        FtpLoginException - if the login is unsuccessful
        FtpProtocolException - if an error occurs
        UnknownHostException - if trying to connect to an unknown host
        SocketTimeoutException - if the timeout expires before the connection can be established
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs while opening the connection.
        另请参阅:
        URLConnection.connected, URLConnection.getConnectTimeout(), URLConnection.setConnectTimeout(int)

      • setConnectTimeout

        public void setConnectTimeout(int timeout)
        从类复制的说明: URLConnection
        Sets a specified timeout value, in milliseconds, to be used when opening a communications link to the resource referenced by this URLConnection. If the timeout expires before the connection can be established, a java.net.SocketTimeoutException is raised. A timeout of zero is interpreted as an infinite timeout.

        Some non-standard implementation of this method may ignore the specified timeout. To see the connect timeout set, please call getConnectTimeout().

        覆盖:
        setConnectTimeout 在类中 URLConnection
        参数:
        timeout - an int that specifies the connect timeout value in milliseconds
        另请参阅:
        URLConnection.getConnectTimeout(), URLConnection.connect()

      • setReadTimeout

        public void setReadTimeout(int timeout)
        从类复制的说明: URLConnection
        Sets the read timeout to a specified timeout, in milliseconds. A non-zero value specifies the timeout when reading from Input stream when a connection is established to a resource. If the timeout expires before there is data available for read, a java.net.SocketTimeoutException is raised. A timeout of zero is interpreted as an infinite timeout.

        Some non-standard implementation of this method ignores the specified timeout. To see the read timeout set, please call getReadTimeout().

        覆盖:
        setReadTimeout 在类中 URLConnection
        参数:
        timeout - an int that specifies the timeout value to be used in milliseconds
        另请参阅:
        URLConnection.getReadTimeout(), InputStream.read()
